clips.title: The story
paras: Captain Nials, at Refuge Pointe, asks for help against the Syndicate holding Northfold Manor. Their hold on the land between the defenders of Stromgarde and Southshore makes it hard for supplies to arrive.

Stromgarde has been carved up between the ogres, the Syndicate and the Alliance, and every faction fights the others to a bloody stalemate. The Alliance's forces dwindle while their enemies grow. The defenders need help from Southshore, but supplies are slow to arrive.

The Syndicate holds the ground between the defenders and Southshore. Captain Nials wants you to go to their base at Northfold Manor and cut down their highwaymen and mercenaries, in the hope that the pressure on the supply trains eases and more get through.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We are fighting a war for Stromgarde, and we are losing. The ogres, the Syndicate and we have divided our once great city, and each faction battles the other into a bloody stalemate.
But our forces dwindle while our enemy grows.
We need help from the town of Southshore, but supplies are difficult to receive while the Syndicate holds territory between us.
Go to the Syndicate base in Northfold Manor and slay them. Then, perhaps, pressure on our supply trains will lessen and more will get through.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, with each passing hour our hold on Stromgarde grows more tenuous. You must make haste or our city will surely fall.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good, friend. With the deaths of those Syndicate members we should have an easier time receiving supplies from Southshore.
Perhaps our cause yet has hope.
